October, nineteen thirty one. I am afraid. I am recording this so that someone will know.
Tonight the Duck quacked my name. Archibald. Very softly. Like a man calling his dog.
Every exhibit in this building walked to the Great Hall and stood around it in a circle. Facing it. Waiting.
I know what must be done. The altar. The fire. But it looked at me, and I wanted so very much to make it happy.
